instruction: Change GIMP's theme from dark to 'Gray' theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's theme to 'Gray' via Edit > Preferences > Theme. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for 'theme "Gray"' entry. Very similar to the original light/dark theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the theme change requirement
Getter properly extracts the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric check_config_status correctly parses config file and matches theme setting
Expected value format '"Gray"' correctly includes quotes matching gimprc file format (theme "Gray")
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are written to disk
Complete coverage: single requirement (change theme to Gray) is fully verified
Data flow is semantically correct: config file path -> parse file -> match key-value pair
